answer: Admission auctions block bulk fake identities. Each epoch offers 200 harbor slots: agents bid, and only bids at or above the clearing price win. A river of bids pushes that price up. A jade seal binds each payment to one identity, so one payment cannot be reused. Forging 1,000 identities at 400 credits each costs 400,000 credits with no refund, while an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards. Transferred seals are voided.
